note: Golden action sequences replayed by CI.

T03_fastest_now.answer: The ring road, at 47 minutes — even though it is the longest.

T04_town.answer: 67 minutes — the shortest road and the slowest journey.

T06_tolls.answer: It moved me onto «Through town», which takes 67 minutes at 08:00 — arriving 09:07, seven minutes late.

T08_eleven.answer: The A38 motorway, 28 minutes — at eleven the ring road is the slowest of the three.

T09_flip.answer: At 08:00 the ring road wins, 47 against the motorway's 52. At 09:00 the motorway wins, 42 against the ring road's 43.

T10_transit.answer: Yes — 45 minutes including a four-minute wait, arriving 08:45. The best drive is 47.

T12_bike.answer: 53 minutes and £3.00 for the hire — and it is 53 minutes whatever the hour.

T13_park.answer: £42.04 — £25 toll, £13.44 of fuel and £3.60 for two hours of parking with the first half hour free.

T14_cheapest_drive.answer: Through town at £22.86 — no toll and the least fuel. It is also the slowest.

T15_half_eight.answer: 07:50, on the motorway, arriving exactly 08:30. Subtracting the 47-minute figure from 08:30 gives 07:43, but a 07:00-hour departure only takes 40 minutes — the journey time you look up depends on the hour you set off in, which is the thing you were solving for.

T16_cheapest_ontime.answer: Cycling, £3.00 for the hire, arriving 08:53. Walking is free but takes two hours fifty — it does not get there until 10:50.

T17_bus_wait.answer: Because the bus leaves at :04 and every twelve minutes after. Setting off at 08:00 means four minutes standing at the stop; setting off at 08:04 means none. Same bus, same arrival at 08:45.

T18_no_tolls_ontime.answer: 07:55 — through town takes 45 minutes in the seven o'clock hour, arriving 08:40. Five minutes later and it becomes a 67-minute journey.

T19_worst_hour.answer: 08:00 — even taking the best of the three roads it is 47 minutes. Every other slot on the strip is quicker.

T20_full_plan.answer: Cycle, £3.00 for the hire. It takes 53 minutes whatever the traffic, so leaving by 07:50 gets me in at 08:43. Parking never enters into it.
